Pac-Man Theme · Adyar, Chennai

House of Cravings

Goal
Build a memorable identity and pre-launch buzz for a new cafe.
My role
Helped create the cafe’s retro Pac-Man arcade theme and designed its Instagram posts around it, using AI tools to produce many posts for customer engagement. Launch lines included “Cravings Lead You Here” and “Cravings Unlocked”.
